design: A fixed fund and three real routes: quick and thin, slow and deep, or lasting but narrow. No route can be fast, fair to every home, and long-lasting at once, so a careful plan can stay inside the red lines but cannot meet every test.
tests_hint: Pays out before Christmas; names who gets what and how much; does not leave out the 1,500 struggling homes; stays within £600,000; has a named person or phone line to call; says how it is checked.
angles: Flat payment to every home in December
